log.title: The nuclear fleet at Algenib
log.message: The Alpha-controlled Syndicate fleet occupies Algenib with nuclear weapons. Enter the system, draw its attention, and cloak to survive while the Oathkeepers move in. Keep the cloak powered for eight seconds, then reach Buccaneer Bay to confirm the fleet has been contained.

log.title: A shadow against the missiles
log.message: The Cloaking Device is installed. Toggle it with C or the Cloak control; watch your energy reserves. Payment: 38,000 credits.

log.title: A shadow against the missiles
log.message: Korban has offered a Cloaking Device for the operation. Take Danforth and the technical team to Hephaestus, where the yard will fit the device before you approach the extremists. The device drains power while concealing your ship.

log.title: Answers at Foundry
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 42,000 credits.

log.title: Answers at Foundry
log.message: With the Pug driven back, Admiral Danforth accompanies you to another meeting with the Syndicate leadership. Alastair Korban must account for a nuclear-armed extremist fleet now controlled by the Alphas.

log.title: The battle at Pugglemug
log.message: The allied fleet holds. The Pug withdraw, leaving more questions than answers, but the invasion is over. Payment: 125,000 credits.

log.title: The lanes reopen
log.message: The human routes are restored. A Pug wormhole remains in Deneb.

log.title: The battle at Pugglemug
log.message: The combined human fleet converges on Deneb. Break the Pug defensive wing, scan the installation, and bring the final report to Pugglemug. The ships around you flew on opposite sides of the war only days ago.

log.title: Ask the ancient ones
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 45,000 credits.

log.title: Ask the ancient ones
log.message: The human fleets need every ally they can find. Carry a delegation to the Quarg. Their reply reminds you how small this war looks to those who have watched civilizations rise and fall.

log.title: New command
log.message: Mule acquired. Your previous ship was traded in; navigation equipment was retained and other outfits refunded.

log.title: A way between the stars
log.message: The recovered Jump Drive is installed. Nearby systems can now be reached even without a hyperlane. Payment: 55,000 credits.

log.title: A way between the stars
log.message: A captured Jump Drive is being studied on Hephaestus. Escort the research shipment home. The device can cross short gaps without a hyperlane and opens routes far beyond human space.

log.title: Hyperspace disruption
log.message: The Pug have severed familiar hyperlanes and formed new links to Deneb. Your chart reflects the changed sky.

log.title: When the lanes went silent
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 65,000 credits.

log.title: When the lanes went silent
log.message: Rand’s transmissions have stopped. Survey the severed hyperlanes from Cebalrai and Ascella, then report to the Free Worlds on New Tibet. The missing links are real: the Pug have changed the routes through human space.

log.title: Hyperspace disruption
log.message: The Pug have severed familiar hyperlanes and formed new links to Deneb. Your chart reflects the changed sky.

log.title: The Soylent trail
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 62,000 credits.

log.title: The Soylent trail
log.message: The Syndicate trail leads to Nimbus and the Soylent. Disable its defenders, board a ship, and recover the records before the evidence disappears.

log.title: Allies beyond the front
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 36,000 credits.

log.title: Allies beyond the front
log.message: Secure support from the Deep and carry the Oathkeepers’ reports to Valhalla. The investigation reaches beyond human fleet movements.

log.title: Before Parliament
log.message: The evidence reaches Parliament. A settlement becomes possible, and the Republic and Free Worlds begin to stand down. Payment: 42,000 credits.

log.title: Before Parliament
log.message: Take the evidence to Earth’s Parliament. The case against the forces prolonging the war must survive both scrutiny and the journey.

log.title: Katya’s evidence
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 50,000 credits.

log.title: Katya’s evidence
log.message: Katya, Sawyer, and Ijs are tracing who has profited from this war. Recover a ship’s records near Mutiny. Evidence, rather than another broadside, may finally change the Republic’s mind.

log.title: The quiet before Rand
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 38,000 credits.

log.title: The quiet before Rand
log.message: Rand’s position near Syndicate space makes it vulnerable. Deliver communications equipment and scan the outer approaches. Something in the traffic does not fit the familiar pattern of war.

log.title: Safe harbor at Albatross
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 36,000 credits.

log.title: The political map changes
log.message: The latest settlement changes the governments and technology available in affected systems.

log.title: Safe harbor at Albatross
log.message: Refugees and intelligence teams need safe passage to Albatross. Get the delegation through while the fleet regroups.

log.title: The trail through Bloodsea
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 44,000 credits.

log.title: The political map changes
log.message: The latest settlement changes the governments and technology available in affected systems.

log.title: The trail through Bloodsea
log.message: The surviving evidence leads through pirate space. Bring down the interception wing and scan Bloodsea’s traffic for the supply trail.

log.title: The raid on Poisonwood
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 60,000 credits.

log.title: The raid on Poisonwood
log.message: The Alphas threaten Poisonwood. Join the defense and retrieve the attackers’ flight records. Allies made here and in the pirate negotiations remember your choices.

log.title: Medicine across the lines
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 34,000 credits.

log.title: Medicine across the lines
log.message: Hospitals are running short of medicine. Escort this shipment through the interdiction wing and land on Clark. The crates are marked with no government’s insignia.

log.title: A web of warnings
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 30,000 credits.

log.title: A web of warnings
log.message: Extend the warning net from Hope and Clark toward New Holland. Deliver the sensor package and perform a calibration scan.

log.title: Secure the northern route
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 36,000 credits.

log.title: The political map changes
log.message: The latest settlement changes the governments and technology available in affected systems.

log.title: Secure the northern route
log.message: The northern route is exposed. Clear the hostile patrol over New Tibet before the next convoy enters the system.

log.title: The journey home
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 20,000 credits.

log.title: The journey home
log.message: Carry the released Navy prisoners to New Iceland under the agreed exchange. The crews are going home because somebody chose to trust the other side.

log.title: Prisoners of the war
log.message: Families are reunited. A channel opens between the opposing governments. Payment: 30,000 credits.

log.title: Prisoners of the war
log.message: Attend the prisoner exchange hearing on New Tibet. Releasing the crews may strengthen Alondo’s diplomacy; holding them gives the fleet bargaining power.

log.title: The southern front
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 52,000 credits.

log.title: The political map changes
log.message: The latest settlement changes the governments and technology available in affected systems.

log.title: The southern front
log.message: The southern fleet is committed. Take your place in the line and clear the opposing screen. Your escort fleet will absorb some incoming fire while set to Protect.

log.title: The ships at Zug
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 40,000 credits.

log.title: The ships at Zug
log.message: Experimental Dreadnoughts are ready for their trial. Clear the threats over Zug and let their crews complete the flight program.

log.title: A workshop on Trinket
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 25,000 credits.

log.title: A workshop on Trinket
log.message: Freya needs the recovered technology at her workshop on Trinket. Deliver the sealed components and help her survey the new weapon’s behavior.

log.title: The electron beam
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 38,000 credits.

log.title: The electron beam
log.message: Navy electron-beam technology could turn the war. Disable a ship near Hope, board it, and recover a weapon record for Freya. Boarding becomes available once the hostile contacts are clear.

log.title: Diplomacy under fire
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 30,000 credits.

log.title: Diplomacy under fire
log.message: Alondo pursues talks with the Republic. Bring his delegation back to New Wales while a naval skirmish threatens the approach.

log.title: The fuel that keeps us moving
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 28,000 credits.

log.title: The fuel that keeps us moving
log.message: A refinery shipment is exposed to interception. Deliver its critical components through the raiders and keep the Free Worlds’ ships in the air.

log.title: A voice in the Senate
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 23,000 credits.

log.title: A voice in the Senate
log.message: Carry the Free Worlds’ arguments to Earth. The Senate must hear why the southern worlds chose independence, even while the fleets prepare for a wider war.

log.title: A bargain with pirates
log.message: The pirate commanders agree to keep the convoy lanes clear. Payment: 23,000 credits.

log.title: The political map changes
log.message: The latest settlement changes the governments and technology available in affected systems.

log.title: A bargain with pirates
log.message: Pirates threaten the supply lines. After breaking their raiding wing, their surviving commanders offer a bargain. The Free Worlds can buy a truce or force submission.

log.title: Freya’s plasma trial
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 24,000 credits.

log.title: Freya’s plasma trial
log.message: Freya’s new plasma weapon needs a combat trial near Rust. Clear the raiders and deliver your readings. Her engineering may give the militia a fighting chance.

log.title: Eyes at Hope
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 18,000 credits.

log.title: Eyes at Hope
log.message: Deploy a sensor package in the approaches to Hope. A small early-warning network may save more lives than a squadron of warships.

log.title: The distant allies
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 19,000 credits.

log.title: The distant allies
log.message: Alondo’s diplomacy reaches the Oathkeepers on Poisonwood. Bring an envoy and relief cargo to hear what help they are willing to give.

log.title: Alondo’s delegation
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 18,000 credits.

log.title: Alondo’s delegation
log.message: Alondo is seeking industrial support for the new government. Take his delegation to Hephaestus and its shipbuilders. Independence will need engines, plates, and a thousand difficult promises.

log.title: The people we capture
log.message: The prisoners return home under parole. Word of your restraint travels ahead of you. Payment: 14,000 credits.

log.title: The people we capture
log.message: The battle has left Navy prisoners in Free Worlds hands. Carry a parole delegation to New Tibet. Your treatment of defeated crews will shape what kind of nation emerges.

log.title: Liberate Kornephoros
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 24,000 credits.

log.title: The political map changes
log.message: The latest settlement changes the governments and technology available in affected systems.

log.title: Liberate Kornephoros
log.message: The Free Worlds move to free Kornephoros. Break the blockade and make contact with the defenders on Clink. This is the first battle of a war nobody can contain.

log.title: The political map changes
log.message: The latest settlement changes the governments and technology available in affected systems.

log.title: A convoy on the edge
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 18,000 credits.

log.title: A convoy on the edge
log.message: A supply convoy must reach Wayfarer. Raiders are stalking the approach. Clear two attackers, then bring the manifest ashore. Upgrade your weapons or hire an escort if the fight is too much.

log.title: The developing base
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 12,000 credits.

log.title: The developing base
log.message: The Navy is building something on New Wales. Approach the system, scan its traffic, and land to compare those readings with the new base. Keep the intelligence away from curious patrols.

log.title: An officer with a cause
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 8,000 credits.

log.title: An officer with a cause
log.message: A militia officer needs a discreet berth. The Free Worlds are organizing, and independent captains will decide whether their people survive the months ahead.

log.title: The Southern Mutual Defense Pact
log.message: Assignment complete. Payment: 8,500 credits.

log.title: The Southern Mutual Defense Pact
log.message: The southern worlds cannot rely on Navy patrols. Survey pirate movements around Glaze and bring your sensor logs to the Pact. In flight, use Scan before landing.

log.title: A captain’s first passage
log.message: James steps onto the wet tarmac. You are no longer merely someone who owns a ship. You are a captain. Payment: 6,500 credits.

log.title: A captain’s first passage
log.message: James, a retired captain, asks for passage to New Greenland. He will help you learn the trade: select a nearby route, launch, jump along the hyperlanes, then land. Cargo contracts and passengers can share a voyage.

log.title: Your first command
log.message: New Boston. A ship, a bank loan, and a sky full of possibilities. Visit the spaceport for work; choose your own course.

Geminus.description: Until recently, Geminus was home to the Republic Navy Yard, the largest shipyard in human space. Now, there is nothing left of the shipyard but a gaping crater in the ground, from the recent terrorist bombing.
Geminus.spaceport: The Navy officers who are in charge here have no time for anyone who is not enlisted in the Navy and participating in the ongoing investigation.

Martini.description: Currently, a massive rescue and evacuation operation is underway in and around the capital to find and treat survivors and contain the radiation. As to be expected, the planet's supplies are running dangerously low, and what remains of Martini's government has called for civilian ships to help deliver goods and provisions for the operation.
Martini.spaceport: Instead of the immaculate spaceport that Martini once sported, this temporary spaceport consists of randomly-scattered makeshift landing areas, in order to support the large number of Navy and civilian ships assisting with the rescue and evacuation operation.

Bourne.description: Bourne is also the seat of government for the newly-formed Free Worlds.

Clink.description: The miners who work here are a tight-knit group, since most of them were part of the original colonization team. They are not particularly open to outsiders, and the facilities here are so rudimentary that they do not even stock fuel for visiting ships.

Deep.spaceport: The spaceport is built on a large island, a now-extinct volcano with an elevation of several kilometers at its center. Most of the large-scale fishing here is done by a single company, Poseidon Industries, which also built and maintains the spaceport. Steep winding roads and sturdy concrete homes and warehouses line the mountain slopes, and below you in the harbor several massive trawling vessels are moored. On the outskirts of the spaceport are the ramshackle houses and open-air marketplace used by the smaller, independent fishing families.

Bloodsea.description: Until recently, this was a pirate world, but as the Free Worlds continued to expand they saw the writing on the wall and decided to become a civilized world. The Free Worlds are building a new spaceport here, but that will take months, and in the meantime the old spaceport is still in use.

New Iceland.description: In the wake of their defeat in the south, the Navy has begun to set up a massive new base here on New Iceland, in order to allow them to continue to have a strong presence in this sector.

Albatross.description: Recently, the Free Worlds have liberated Albatross from their pirate oppressors, but many of the locals remain skeptical, seeing the Free Worlds as little different from the other protection rackets that have held sway over them.
